title: Stochastic Matching Bandits with Rare Optimization Updates
abstract: arXiv:2509.04194v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We introduce a bandit framework for stochastic matching under the multinomial logit (MNL) choice model. In this setting, $N$ agents on one side are assigned to $K$ arms on the other side, where each arm stochastically selects an agent from its assigned pool according to unknown preferences and yields a corresponding reward over a horizon $T$. The objective is to minimize regret by maximizing the cumulative revenue from successful matches. A naive approach requires solving an NP-hard combinatorial optimization problem at every round, resulting in a prohibitive computational cost. To address this challenge, we propose batched algorithms that strategically limit the number of times matching assignments are updated to $\Theta(\log\log T)$ over the entire horizon. translated_title: 基于稀疏优化更新的随机匹配老虎机
translated_abstract: 我们提出了一个在多项Logit（MNL）选择模型下的随机匹配老虎机框架。在该设定中，一侧的 $N$ 个智能体被分配到另一侧的 $K$ 个臂上，每个臂根据未知的偏好从其分配池中随机选择一个智能体，并在时间范围 $T$ 内产生相应的奖励。目标是通过最大化成功匹配的累积收益来最小化遗憾。一种朴素的方法需要在每一轮都求解一个NP难的组合优化问题，导致极其高昂的计算成本。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了批处理算法，将匹配分配的更新次数在整个时间范围内策略性地限制在 $\Theta(\log\log T)$ 次。通过仅在极小比例的轮次中调用昂贵的组合优化，我们的算法大幅降低了总体计算开销，同时仍然实现……
tldr: 本文提出了MNL选择模型下随机匹配老虎机的批处理算法，通过将昂贵的匹配优化更新次数限制在Θ(log log T)次，在大幅降低计算开销的同时保持了遗憾最优性能。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes batched algorithms for stochastic matching bandits under the MNL choice model, which limit expensive optimization updates to only Θ(log log T) times, substantially reducing computational overhead while maintaining optimal regret performance.
